blind_spots.blind_spot: No mention anywhere of ATO/RMF, STIGs, or IL4/IL5 despite selling a PNT module meant to plug into government drone/comms networks.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A hardware module that talks PNT/timing data into a Blue-sUAS platform still needs to cross an ATO before it touches a program-of-record network — 'plug and play module compatible with blue-SUAS certified drones' assumes an integration path that skips this entirely.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Team is RF/PNT engineering-heavy (digital signal processing, RTOS, embedded) with no visible compliance or field-integration hire.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: 'This module will enable drones to use HSN-based PNT solution when GPS is jammed or unavailable, and go back to using GPS again when available.'

blind_spots.blind_spot: No mention of ATAK/TAK ecosystem despite building position/timing data explicitly meant to feed situational-awareness and C2 pictures.
blind_spots.operator_reality: PNT data that isn't natively pipeable into ATAK means an operator has to bridge it manually in the field — exactly the kind of last-mile integration gap that kills a transition when nobody funded the adapter.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Product framing is 'PNT services to mobile units' at the RF-network level, not at the C2-display level where TAK lives.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: 'network-wide PNT services to all the mobile units as part of a highly secure mobile communication network'

blind_spots.blind_spot: Zero language on who trains an operator to deploy/troubleshoot a 'self-expanding mesh network' node in the field, or battery/spares logistics for the mesh hardware.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A self-organizing mesh still needs someone to physically place, power, and diagnose a dead node at 0300 in a GPS-denied site — 'no limit on the number of nodes' says nothing about who services node #14 when it drops.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Messaging is pitched at the RF/network-engineering layer (self-organizing, self-healing) which implicitly assumes the hardware just works, not at the sustainment layer.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: 'Hyper Sync Net's Self-Expanding capabilities allows nodes to seamlessly join the mesh network and there is no limit on the number of nodes (Infinity Mesh) joining the network.'

opener_hook: Your 2022 AFRL Phase II names Maj. Devin Beckwith's SOF unit as the target end user for HSN-based drone PNT — how's the ATO clock tracking against their fielding window?
what_they_do: GPS-denied position/navigation/timing and wireless mesh time-sync hardware for drones and tactical comms.
